What they need:
The decision (clear),
rationale (sharp),
alternatives considered,
what changes for them

span.p:
What they need:
What they will do,
what is NOT changing,
when more detail comes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What they need:
What changes for them,
when, what is NOT changing,
who they go to with concerns

span.p:
What they need:
What changed, why,
what (if anything) is asked

(required for any decision
